econometric_drivers.title: Tri-State Econometric Drivers & Cross-River Arbitrage
econometric_drivers.description: Models consumer cross-river refuel switching between Hamilton County OH and Northern Kentucky (Kenton/Boone counties) driven by the persistent $0.125/gal state fuel tax differential.

refining_logistics.title: Refining & River Inland Waterway Logistics
refining_logistics.description: Cincinnati marine terminals (Mile 470 on Ohio River) receive refined fuel via barges coming up the Lower Mississippi River through the Cairo IL confluence, supplemented by Marathon's 291,000 bpd Catlettsburg KY refinery and Buckeye Pipeline.

tax_structure.title: Dual-State Tax Structure & Statutory Fees
tax_structure.description: Ohio state fuel tax ($0.385/gal) vs Kentucky state fuel tax ($0.260/gal) combined with US Federal excise tax ($0.184/gal) creates total tax loads of $0.569/gal in OH vs $0.444/gal in KY.
tax_structure.notes: Ohio $0.385/gal vs Kentucky $0.260/gal creates persistent $0.125/gal cross-river gap

infrastructure_delivery.title: Dual-State Delivery Hub & Rack Margin Equations
infrastructure_delivery.description: Reflects the $0.125/gal state fuel tax differential across the Ohio River metropolitan boundary.
